title: HUMAN NUTRITION SCIENCE: MACRONUTRIENTS
description: Examines macronutrient biochemistry and nutritional physiology in detail. Reviews the digestion, absorption, transport, storage, metabolism, excretion and functions of carbohydrates, protein, lipids, water and ethanol in humans. Integrates this metabolic information to consider impacts on human health from research, clinical and health promotions vantages. Develops nutrition research and concept communication skills.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BB 350*, 450* or 492*.
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of C- is required in BB 350, BB 450 and BB 492.
